title: West Pakistan Press and Publications Punjab Amendment Act 1973

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Press and Publications Punjab Amendment Act 1973
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XIII OF 1973
ACT XIII OF 1973
WEST PAKISTAN
PRESS AND PUBLICATIONS (PUNJAB AMENDMENT) ACT, 1973
An Act further to
amend the West Pakistan Press and Publications ordinance, 1963 (West Pakistan
Ordinance No. XXX of 1963), to its application to the Province of the Punjab
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 26th June 1973]
[First published, after having
received the assent of the Governor of the Punjab, in the Gazette of the Punjab
(Extraordinary), dated the 26th June 1973].
No. PAP/Legis-2(11)/73/139.---The
West Pakistan Press and Publica tions (Punjab Amendment) Bill, 1973, having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 12th c ay of June
1973, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 25th day of June
1973, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the
Punjab.
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the West Pakistan Press and
Publications (Punjab Amendment) Act, 1973.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the day the West
Pakistan Press and Publications (Punjab Amendment) Ordinance, 1972 (Punjab
Ordinance No. XXIII of 1972), ceased to operate in accordance with the
provisions of clause (2) (a) of Article 135 of the Interim Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

No. PAP/Legis-2(11)/73/139.---The

1973, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 25th day of June

2. Amendment of section 10 of
West Pakistan Ordinance XXX of 1963.---In the West Pakistan Press and
Publications Ordinance, 1963, In its application to the Province of the Punjab,
in. section 10, for the words and figures "if within 24 hours of such
temporary change the District Magistrate is informed of it in the manner
prescribed" occurring at the end, the words, commas and colon-
"if within 72 hours of such
temporary change, approval in writing, of the District Magistrate within whose
jurisdiction the newspaper is printed or published, and in the case of
temporary change from one district to another district, of the District
Magistrate of the other district, to such temporary change is obtained:
Provided that no such approval
shall be accorded unless the printer or the publisher, as the case may be,
satisfies the District Magistrate concerned that such change was
unavoidable" shall be substituted.

3. Repeal had validation.---(1)
The Punjab Ordinances Temporary Enactment Act, 1973, in so far as it enacts the
provisions of the West Pakistan Press and Publications (Punjab Amendment)
Ordinance, . 1972 (Punjab Ordinance No. XXIII of 1972), is hereby repealed.
(2) Everything done, action taken
or order made under the West Pakistan Press and Publications (Punjab Amendment)
Ordinance, 1972 (Punjab Ordinance No. XXIII of 1972), and its provisions as
enacted by the Punjab Ordinances Temporary Enactment Act, 1973, on or after the
15th November 1972 and before the commencement of thi3 Act, shall be deemed to
have been validly done or made.
